# An invoice naming a transaction that has no side outside the bank account to
# retarget — every split of it is on `Assets:Bank`.
#
# Nothing is spoken for here; there is simply nothing there, and a message
# about splits that already settle invoices would describe a book this is not.
invoice "INV-NO-OTHER-SIDE"
